item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-23
item.description: China launches WAICO, a 29-nation AI governance bloc backing open-source AI; Mulan License Family donated to OpenAtom Foundation; China's anthropomorphic AI rules take effect; Beijing weighs export controls on its own AI models.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-22
item.description: US Treasury threatens sanctions on Chinese open-source AI models over IP theft; MIT Technology Review analyzes how Chinese AI divides Trump's camp; China explicitly champions open source at UN's first global AI governance dialogue.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-21
item.description: NDRC eight-point AI Action Plan, Trump admin considers ban on Chinese open-source models, Mulan copyleft license submitted to OSI, and Qiushi essay on AI ideology

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-20
item.description: WAICO founded, Kimi K3 released as largest open-source model, Xi calls for open collaboration at WAIC 2026, and openKylin advances AI-native OS

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-19
item.description: Xi Jinping champions open-source AI at WAIC 2026; Moonshot's Kimi K3 becomes the largest open-weight model ever; China releases AI cooperation action plan; Beijing studies export controls on frontier models.
